mechanics.name: Wooden Stake
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Cheap floor spike made from logs. Anything standing in it, players included, takes 1 armour-ignoring damage per hit, and wave mobs on it get Slowness I. Each stake a player places has 20 HP that nearby wave mobs wear down. At 0 HP it vanishes with no drop.
key_numbers: Recipe: 3 logs in a diagonal make 4 stakes (stake_recipe.json in the jar; tier1_recipes.js:1-5 keeps the stock recipe)

Damage per hit = 1.0 x StakeDamageMultiplier 1.0 (StakeEntityCollidesInTheBlockProcedure: dconst_1 * STAKEDMG; simplytraps.toml:2). It hits on even-dayTime ticks (wave_mob_spike_slow.js:3-5), about 2/s after i-frames (tooltip_tier_colors.js:44)
Damage type minecraft:generic is in vanilla bypasses_armor (1.20.1 jar tag), so it ignores armour
Wave-mob slow: Slowness I for 30 ticks, re-applied once it drops below 20 ticks (wave_mob_spike_slow.js:19)

HP 20 (trap_durability.js:16). Every 20 ticks it loses the summed attack damage of the td_wave_mob mobs within 1.2 blocks, so a plain zombie (3 attack) breaks it in about 7 s (trap_durability.js:12-13,29,31,101-158)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: 3 logs for 4 stakes, available from the start. Oak logs come from Uncommon bags (weight 70/391, 4-8 per roll; bountybags/loot_tables/items/uncommon.json) and scav_building chests.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'Cheap and Cheerful' (campaign.snbt:537-569): item task with subtitle '3 logs'; rewards 6 stakes and 1 level. The text (1 damage a step, hurts you too, slows a little, wears down fast) matches the code.
detection_options: Keep the item task (consume_items:false)

KubeJS BlockEvents.placed('simply_traps:stake') -> 'execute as <uuid> run ftbquests change_progress @s complete <customTaskId>' (the qmCompleteForPlayer pattern in quest_milestones.js:57-66), so the task means 'lay a line', not just 'craft one'
Observation task, observe_type BLOCK, to_observe simply_traps:stake
A shared custom task fired from trap_durability.js's worn-out branch (lines 143-156): 'your first trap breaks', which teaches wear
mechanics.teaching_hook: It hurts you too, and it is consumable: every wave mob on or beside it drains its 20 HP, so stake lines need rebuilding between waves. Mobs are only slowed while they stand on it.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: No owner, so anyone can break it. The HP registry is shared world state (td_trapRegistry in worldData; trap_durability.js:9-10). An item task completes for the whole FTB party. Rewards are per player (data.snbt:6 default_reward_team: false), so each member claims the 6 stakes.
reward_candidates: a handful of stakes as a restock

mechanics.name: Stake Wall
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Upright stake panel with the stake's damage (1 per hit, ignores armour) and Slowness I. It has no collision, so mobs push through it and take damage and slowness on the way. The base's outer walls come lined with Stake Walls that never wear out. Ones a player places have 20 HP.
key_numbers: Recipe: 4 logs make 4 Stake Walls (stake_wall_recipe.json, stock)
Damage per hit = 1.0 x StakeWallDamageMultiplier 1.0 (simplytraps.toml:1; StakeWallEntityCollidesInTheBlockProcedure)
No collision; it hurts any entity whose hitbox overlaps it (wave_mob_spike_slow.js:3-5)
Slowness I for 30 ticks (wave_mob_spike_slow.js:20)
HP 20 for player-placed walls (trap_durability.js:17). The walls on the base are placed by setblock and never tracked, so they last (trap_durability.js:5-7; playtest_starter_kit.js:775-776)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: 4 logs for 4, available from the start.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: No quest. The tier tooltip lists it as Tier 1 (tooltip_tier_colors.js:16,46).
detection_options: Item task for simply_traps:stake_wall
Observation BLOCK simply_traps:stake_wall. The player is already looking at them on the base walls, which suits an early 'notice the walls' quest
BlockEvents.placed custom task
mechanics.teaching_hook: Despite the name it does not block anything: zombies walk through it bleeding and slowed. The base's own stake walls are permanent, but the ones you add wear out.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: No owner. Placed walls share the world trap registry.

mechanics.name: Spike Trap
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Iron floor spikes that deal 4 armour-ignoring damage per hit. Wave mobs on it get Slowness III, which lingers about 3 s after they step off. A placed trap has 60 HP, three times a stake's.
key_numbers: Recipe: 5 iron ingots in an X make 1 (tier1_recipes.js:11-18). This replaces the stock 3 iron bars + 3 smooth stone slabs for 4
Damage = 2.0 (ldc in SpikeTrapEntityWalksOnTheBlockProcedure) x SpikeDamageMultiplier 2.0 (simplytraps.toml:3) = 4 per hit, about 8/s (tooltip_tier_colors.js:45)
Slowness III (amplifier 2) for 60 ticks, re-applied below 50 (wave_mob_spike_slow.js:18)
HP 60 (trap_durability.js:18)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: 5 iron ingots each. Iron comes from Uncommon bags (3-5 per roll, weight 30/391), Rare bags and scav_hardware.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'Better Than Nothing' (campaign.snbt:570-602): item task with subtitle '5 iron ingots'; rewards 4 spike traps and 1 level. The text (4 damage, hard slow that lingers, outlasts a stake) matches the code.
detection_options: Item task (existing)
BlockEvents.placed('simply_traps:spike_trap') custom task
KubeJS hurt hook: wave_mob_spike_slow.js already finds the strongest trap under a mob (strongestTrapSlowUnder, lines 40-59). One call could fire a shared 'first mob pinned by spikes' milestone
mechanics.teaching_hook: The slowness outlasts the trap by about 3 s, so place spikes inside the reach of your Sentry, I.M.S. or Tesla Coil. A horde caught on spikes stays in the kill zone longer.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: Shared world registry and no owner. The reward of 4 traps is paid to every party member (default_reward_team: false), which is 20 iron worth per player.
reward_candidates: 2 spike traps instead of 4, so a party of 4 is not flooded

mechanics.name: Trap wear (HP pools on placed traps)
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Traps a player places are not permanent. Once a second, each one loses HP equal to the combined attack damage of the wave mobs touching it. At 0 HP it breaks with wood or metal particles and a sound, and drops nothing. Structure mobs never wear traps, and the base's pre-built Stake Walls never wear.
key_numbers: Stake 20 HP, Stake Wall 20 HP, Spike Trap 60 HP (trap_durability.js:16-18)
Reach 1.2 blocks from the trap centre to the mob's feet (trap_durability.js:29)
Check every 20 ticks (trap_durability.js:31)
Only td_wave_mob counts (trap_durability.js:113-115)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: Applies automatically to every placed Simply Traps block.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: Mentioned qualitatively in 'Cheap and Cheerful' ('worn down fast') and 'Better Than Nothing' ('holds up longer'). No numbers, and nothing says the trap breaks with no drop.
detection_options: Shared custom task fired from trap_durability.js's break branch (lines 143-156), for example qmCompleteShared(server, data, 'trapWorn') from quest_milestones.js:49-55. No new tick cost: the branch already runs
mechanics.teaching_hook: Big hitters wear traps faster, because the drain equals the mob's attack damage. Plan to rebuild your trap lines in the gap between waves.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: The registry lives on the pedestal marker, so it is shared by the party.

mechanics.name: Lure Block
mechanics.player_facing_summary: A one-use bait crate. While it lasts, every wave mob within 40 blocks turns off the pedestal and heads for the lure. It lasts 60 s and shows a countdown nameplate, with a bell every 5 s, then destroys itself. Breaking it early gives nothing back. A mob that a player is standing right in front of, or that a player just hit, still goes for that player first.
key_numbers: Recipe FRF/RTR/FRF: 4 rotten flesh, 4 redstone, 1 target block (lure_block.js:5-15)
Duration 1200 ticks = 60 s (lure_block.js:17)
Pull radius 40 blocks, horizontal (lure_block.js:20)
Last 100 ticks: red nameplate and a smoke puff (lure_block.js:21,130-132)
Bell every 5 s (lure_block.js:23,126-129)
Hardness 0.5, no drops (startup_scripts/lure_block.js:9-13)
Target priority: a blocking player in melee range, then a player who hit the mob (8 s window), then the lure, then the pedestal (mob_aggro.js:4-8,133)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: 4 rotten flesh, 4 redstone and a target block (vanilla target = hay bale + 4 redstone).
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'Dinner Bell' (campaign.snbt:603-635): item task with subtitle 'A Target block, 4 redstone, 4 rotten flesh'; rewards 1 level and 2 redstone. The text (40 blocks, 60 s, bell, breaks itself, the player-priority exception) matches the code.
detection_options: Item task (existing)
BlockEvents.placed('kubejs:lure_block') custom task: 'Ring the bell'
Count the wave mobs whose current target is a td_lure_target marker; mob_aggro.js already resolves this every 10 ticks. A 'Lure 10 mobs' custom task would need no extra scan
mechanics.teaching_hook: Place it past your spike line so the horde has to walk the traps to reach it. Standing next to mobs, or hitting them, overrides the lure for you.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: The lure is a world entity, so it pulls mobs away from everyone. Its countdown advances only while a player is online in that dimension (PlayerEvents.tick, lure_block.js:106-114).

mechanics.name: Bouncing Betty
mechanics.player_facing_summary: A buried mine. When something steps on it, it hops up and explodes 16 ticks later. The blast does up to 85 damage and reaches 12 blocks, but it never hurts players, dropped loot or blocks. It is also the I.M.S. ammo and a Claymore ingredient.
key_numbers: Recipe ' P '/'IGI': heavy weighted pressure plate + 2 iron + 1 gunpowder, kept stock (securitycraft_traps.js:52); 4 iron in total (securitycraft_traps.js:26)
Explosion power 6.0 (BouncingBetty.explode picks 3.0f/6.0f; smallerMineExplosion=false, securitycraft-server.toml:10): up to 85 damage, 12-block reach (tooltip_tier_colors.js:47)
Fuse 15, so it explodes on the 16th tick (mine_player_safety.js:11-17)
No block damage (securitycraft-common.toml:2; securitycraft-server.toml:14) and no fire (securitycraft-server.toml:8)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: 4 iron and 1 gunpowder. Gunpowder comes from Uncommon bags (15/391) and scav_hardware.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'Bouncing Betty' (campaign.snbt:719-745): item task, subtitle correct. The text 'it doesn't care who trips it - keep it off your own patrol routes' implies it can hurt the player, but players are always stripped from friendly blasts (explosion_player_safety.js:16-47; mine_player_safety.js:76-118). The only real cost of tripping it is a wasted mine. The quest gives no blast numbers.
detection_options: Item task
BlockEvents.placed custom task
Shared milestone from mine_player_safety.js's Betty blast match (the bettyIdx branch, lines 98-117): 'your first mine goes off'
mechanics.teaching_hook: Keep a stack: it is a mine, the I.M.S.'s refill, and the core of a Claymore. Stepping on your own Betty wastes it but cannot hurt you.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: It belongs to whoever placed it. Non-owners cannot break SecurityCraft blocks (allow_breaking_non_owned_blocks=false, securitycraft-server.toml:107), and FTB Teams co-ownership is off (enable_team_ownership=false, securitycraft-server.toml:30).

mechanics.name: Claymore
mechanics.player_facing_summary: A directional mine. Anything that walks into the zone up to 5 blocks in front of it trips it, and it explodes about a second later for up to 50 damage within 7 blocks. Wire Cutters defuse it so it can be moved, and flint and steel re-arms it.
key_numbers: Recipe HSH/SBS/RGR: 2 tripwire hooks, 3 string, 1 Bouncing Betty, 2 redstone, 1 gunpowder (claymore.json, stock per securitycraft_traps.js:52)
Explosion power 3.5 (ClaymoreBlock.explode picks 1.5f/3.5f): up to 50 damage, 7-block reach (tooltip_tier_colors.js:48)
Range option: default 5, adjustable 1-10 (ClaymoreBlockEntity IntOption 'range')
Targeting option defaults to PLAYERS_AND_MOBS (ClaymoreBlockEntity), and no pack script changes it. Players still take no damage (explosion_player_safety.js)
Placed Claymores are tracked in td_claymoreRegistry (mine_player_safety.js:8-10,34-54)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: Consumes a Bouncing Betty plus string, tripwire hooks, redstone and gunpowder (scav_hardware carries tripwire hooks and string).
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'Claymore' (campaign.snbt:746-772): item task; the subtitle and text match the code and SecurityCraft's help text. It depends on 'Bouncing Betty', which mirrors the recipe.
detection_options: Item task
BlockEvents.placed custom task
Shared milestone from mine_player_safety.js's matchedClaymore branch (lines 86-96)
Item task for securitycraft:wire_cutters as a 'tool' sub-quest
mechanics.teaching_hook: It only fires forward. Aim it down a lane. Defuse it with Wire Cutters (shears + 4 iron) before moving it.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: Owned by the placer; only the owner can break it (securitycraft-server.toml:107).

mechanics.name: Sentry
mechanics.player_facing_summary: The first automatic gun. Place it on a solid block and it shoots hostile mobs within 20 blocks, twice a second, for 8 damage per bullet, with unlimited ammo. It starts out targeting hostile mobs only, whatever its placement message says. Only the player who placed it can change its mode, add modules or pick it up.
key_numbers: Recipe SDR/IPI/IBI: 1 Shrapnel, Dispenser, redstone, 4 iron, Portable Radar (7 iron + redstone torch + redstone), iron block; 20 iron in total (securitycraft_traps.js:7-22; portable_radar.json)
Bullet damage 8 (securitycraft-server.toml:77). This is a SERVER config, applied to new worlds only (:70-74)
Fires every 10 ticks (2/s), or every 5 with a Speed Module (Sentry.getShootingSpeed)
Target range 20 blocks (Sentry.MAX_TARGET_DISTANCE = 20.0f)
Spawned or loaded in CAMOUFLAGE_HP, it is switched to mode ordinal 4, AGGRESSIVE_H: always on, hostiles only (sentry_default_mode.js:3,10-18)
It needs a solid block underneath or it discards itself (playtest_starter_kit.js:465-466)
Firing feedback: tracer, crit burst and sound (sentry_combat_feedback.js:6-82)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: Needs Shrapnel, which only comes from fighting, plus 20 iron and a dispenser (bow, cobblestone, redstone). The boss also drops one Sentry (boss_wave.js:183).
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'Sentry' (campaign.snbt:773-799): item task, subtitle correct. The text says it never runs out of 'arrows' (it fires bullets) 'unless you load something else into a locked chest underneath it'. That route needs a passcode-protected chest, made with a Keypad, which takes 8 reinforced stone buttons (keypad_item.json). Reinforced stone needs the Universal Block Reinforcer, which has no recipe (securitycraft_traps.js:54-58), so the route is unreachable in practice. The quest never says only the owner can interact with it, that it needs a solid block, or that it already starts hostile-only. It depends on 'Claymore', a design gate rather than a recipe link.
detection_options: Item task
Observation task, observe_type ENTITY_TYPE, to_observe securitycraft:sentry (proves one was placed)
KubeJS EntityEvents.hurt: sentry_combat_feedback.js:67-82 already identifies Sentry hits, so a shared 'first Sentry hit' milestone needs no extra scan
EntityEvents.death of a td_wave_mob with a Sentry as the source owner: 'Sentry kill' custom task
mechanics.teaching_hook: Ignore the 'Camouflage' placement message: it is already set to hostiles only. Only the person who placed it can reconfigure it. A Speed Module (7 iron, paper, sugar) doubles its fire rate.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: Owner-only interaction (Sentry's interact method checks isOwnedBy). Team co-ownership is off (securitycraft-server.toml:28-34), so a teammate cannot change its mode, add modules or move it.

mechanics.name: Electrified Iron Fence
mechanics.player_facing_summary: A fence that zombies will not path through. Once a second, every hostile mob standing right beside it takes 6 armour-ignoring electric damage. It never hurts players or Sentries. It is also the 'brain' that the Chemthrower Turret recipe consumes.
key_numbers: Recipe ' I '/'IFI'/' I ': 4 iron + 1 oak fence (securitycraft_traps.js:41-50)

Pack shock: every 20 ticks, 6 damage of type securitycraft:electricity to MONSTER-category mobs within 0.5 block of their hitbox, at feet level and one block up (wave_mob_fence_shock.js:13-17,21-36,40-55)
securitycraft:electricity bypasses armour (SecurityCraft's bypasses_armor tag)

The mod's own contact shock also fires on a 20-tick cadence: 6 to players, a lightning hit to mobs (ElectrifiedIronFenceBlock.hurtOrConvertEntity). Players are always protected (electric_trap_player_safety.js:11-12,26-41)
Pathfinding treats fences as impassable (wave_mob_fence_shock.js:3-6)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: 4 iron and an oak fence.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'Electrified Fence' (campaign.snbt:800-826): item task, subtitle correct. 'Shocks any mob that touches it' is narrower than the code, which shocks mobs within 0.5 block. 'Unbreakable' is not true for the owner: vanilla_tool_block_breaking=true (securitycraft-server.toml:101) lets the owner mine it, and only non-owners cannot (:107). The quest gives no damage figure. 'It never hurts a player' is correct.
detection_options: Item task
BlockEvents.placed custom task
Shared milestone fired the first time wave_mob_fence_shock.js shocks a mob (inside its existing 20-tick loop)
Death classification by damage type securitycraft:electricity (bountyDamageTypeId in bounty_kills.js) for a 'fence kill' custom task
mechanics.teaching_hook: Zombies will not path through fences, so use fences to build funnels, and anything waiting beside one takes 6 damage a second. Build an extra fence: the Chemthrower Turret recipe eats one.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: Owned by the placer, and only the owner can break it. The starter gate fences are claimed by the first player to log in (playtest_starter_kit.js:1363-1378).

mechanics.name: I.M.S. (Intelligent Munitions System)
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Holds 4 Bouncing Betties and launches them as homing bombs at hostile mobs within 15 blocks, one every 4 s. Each blast does up to 99 damage. It reloads itself one Betty at a time from any inventory placed directly under it. Refilling by hand only works for the owner. Breaking it returns at most 2 Betties.
key_numbers: Recipe 'BPB'/' I ': 2 Bouncing Betties, Portable Radar, 1 iron ingot; 16 iron in total (securitycraft_traps.js:24-35)
Starts with 4 bombs (IMSBlockEntity: bombsRemaining = 4)
Range option: default 15, adjustable 1-30 (IMSBlockEntity IntOption 'range')
Attack interval 80 ticks (4 s), or 40 with a Speed Module (IMSBlockEntity.getAttackInterval)
Bomb explosion power 7.0 (IMSBomb picks 3.5f/7.0f): up to 99 damage, 14-block reach (tooltip_tier_colors.js:51)
Auto-reload: while it holds fewer than 4, it pulls one securitycraft:bouncing_betty from the item handler of the block below (IMSBlockEntity.tick, lambda$tick$0)
Breaking it drops at most 2 Betties (securitycraft_traps.js:61-71)
Switched to MOBS targeting on placement (sentry_default_mode.js:20-45)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: 2 Bouncing Betties and a Portable Radar. Running cost: one Betty (4 iron + gunpowder) per shot.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: 'I.M.S.' (campaign.snbt:827-853): item task, subtitle correct. The text (4 Betties, tracking, refill by right-click, at most 2 back) is correct. It does not mention the reload from a container underneath, that hand-refill is owner-only (IMSBlock.use checks isOwnedBy), or the 15-block range and 4 s interval.
detection_options: Item task
KubeJS check (in an existing throttled tick, or on BlockEvents.placed of a chest) that a container with Betties sits directly under an I.M.S.: 'Automate the reload' custom task
EntityEvents.spawned('securitycraft:imsbomb'): a shared 'first launch' milestone
mechanics.teaching_hook: Put a chest of Bouncing Betties directly underneath it and it reloads itself, which is also how a teammate can keep your I.M.S. fed. A Speed Module halves the reload. Modules go in through a Universal Block Modifier (emerald + 2 iron + 2 redstone).
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: Owner-only hand refill and configuration. Feeding it from a chest underneath works for anyone.
reward_candidates: 4 Bouncing Betties as a full reload

mechanics.name: SecurityCraft Mine, block mines and Track Mine (craftable, not in the roster)
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Stock SecurityCraft mines that no script removes, so they show in JEI and can be crafted. Mine: 3 iron + 1 gunpowder makes 3, and it explodes when stepped on. Block mines are a block plus a Mine and look exactly like that block; a sand mine is perfect camouflage in the desert. Track Mine: 7 iron, stick and gunpowder make 6, and it is triggered only by minecarts.
key_numbers: Mine: ' I '/'IGI' makes 3 (mine.json). Power 3.0 (MineBlock.explode picks 1.0f/3.0f): up to 43 damage, 6-block reach (vanilla 14*power+1)
Block mines: shapeless block + Mine (for example sand_mine.json). Power 5.0 (BaseFullMineBlock.explode picks 2.5f/5.0f): up to 71 damage, 10-block reach
Track Mine: 'I I'/'ISI'/'IGI' makes 6. Power 6.0 (TrackMineBlock)
No pack recipe removal covers them (securitycraft_traps.js only removes the Sentry, I.M.S., Trophy System, Cage Trap, fence and Reinforcer recipes)
Friendly-blast handling covers them generically: a null exploder counts as friendly (explosion_player_safety.js:45-47)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: Very cheap. A Mine costs about 1 iron each, against 4 iron for a Bouncing Betty.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: No quest, and absent from tooltip_tier_colors.js. Whether these were meant to be cut is unverified; nothing in the docs mentions them.
detection_options: Item task
BlockEvents.placed custom task (for example 'Hide a Sand Mine')
mechanics.teaching_hook: A Sand Mine looks exactly like the desert floor.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: Owned by the placer (SecurityCraft ownership rules).

mechanics.name: SecurityCraft utility kit: Wire Cutters, modules, Universal Block Modifier, Taser, Remote Access Sentry
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Support items that upgrade Tier 2. Wire Cutters defuse mines. A Speed Module doubles the fire rate of a Sentry or I.M.S. The Universal Block Modifier opens a block's options and module slots. The Taser is a self-recharging stun gun: on hit, Weakness, Nausea and Slowness III for 10 s. The Remote Access Sentry changes the modes of bound Sentries from a distance.
key_numbers: Wire Cutters: shears + 4 iron (wire_cutters.json)
Speed Module: 7 iron + paper + sugar (speed_module.json). Sentry fire interval 10 -> 5 ticks (Sentry.getShootingSpeed); I.M.S. 80 -> 40 ticks (IMSBlockEntity.getAttackInterval)
Universal Block Modifier: emerald + 2 iron + 2 redstone (universal_block_modifier.json)

Taser: bow, 2 gold, iron, redstone, 2 sticks (taser.json). Damage 1.0; Weakness, Nausea and Slowness at amplifier 2 for 200 ticks (securitycraft-server.toml:44-51). Powered taser: 2.0 damage, amplifier 5 for 400 ticks (:47,55)
Remote Access Sentry: diamond, 6 iron, redstone torch, stick (remote_access_sentry.json)
mechanics.unlock_or_cost: Sugar (scav_dairy), paper (scav_filler) and emeralds (Uncommon quest rewards, MID/HIGH stash pools) come from loot.
mechanics.current_quest_coverage: Only the 'Claymore' quest names Wire Cutters and flint and steel. Modules, the Universal Block Modifier, the Taser and the remote have no quest.
detection_options: Item tasks per tool (one quest per item, per the IDEAS.md:278-285 working principle)
KubeJS entity interaction with a Sentry while holding a speed_module: 'Overclock' custom task
mechanics.teaching_hook: The cheapest damage upgrade in Tier 2 is the Speed Module: it doubles a Sentry's or I.M.S.'s output for 7 iron.
mechanics.multiplayer_notes: Modules can only be inserted by the owner of the target block or entity.
reward_candidates: Speed Module (fits a Sentry or I.M.S. milestone)

Boss: 12 (boss_wave.js:184)

Tooltip: 'Scrap metal salvaged from the fight - fuel for Tier 2 tech.' (shrapnel.js:8)

mechanics.name: Friendly-fire and block safety for player defences
mechanics.player_facing_summary: Explosions from your mines, I.M.S. bombs, turret shells, grenades and bazooka never hurt players, never destroy dropped items or XP orbs, and never break blocks. The pedestal and the airdrop beacon survive any explosion. The Tesla Coil and electrified fence never shock players or Sentries. Two exceptions: Simply Traps spikes and stakes DO hurt players, and the Demolition Zombie's TNT is an enemy blast.
key_numbers: Friendly blast = exploder is null, a player or a Sentry; it spares players, minecraft:item and minecraft:experience_orb, and removes every affected block (explosion_player_safety.js:16-29,45-47)
The pedestal block and the airdrop beacon are removed from every explosion's block list (explosion_player_safety.js:33-43)
OMT turrets cannot target players (omtreborn-common.toml:20), and their projectiles cannot destroy blocks (:11-13)
Damage types ieTesla, ieTeslaPrimary and securitycraft.electricity are cancelled for players and Sentries (electric_trap_player_safety.js:11-12,26-41)

notes: Multiplayer reward inflation: data.snbt:6 sets default_reward_team: false, so every party member claims their own copy of each reward (FTB Quests Reward.isTeamReward falls back to BaseQuestFile.isDefaultPerTeamReward). Item rewards such as 'Better Than Nothing''s 4 Spike Traps are multiplied by the party size. Consider team_reward: true on bulk item rewards and keep per-player rewards for personal items (guns, ammo) and XP.

FTB Quests 2001.4.22 task types (TaskTypes.class): item, checkmark, kill, location, dimension, structure, biome, observation, stat, advancement, xp, custom, fluid, gamestage (needs Game Stages, which is not installed), plus forge_energy (ForgeEnergyTask, fed through a Task Screen). Observation types: BLOCK, BLOCK_TAG, BLOCK_STATE, BLOCK_ENTITY, BLOCK_ENTITY_TYPE, ENTITY_TYPE, ENTITY_TYPE_TAG. StatTask reads only minecraft:custom stats, so it cannot detect item use or block placement. Placement detection needs KubeJS BlockEvents.placed plus change_progress on a custom task (the quest_milestones.js:57-66 pattern), or an observation task as a proxy.

Detection hooks already in code, with no new tick cost: sentry_combat_feedback.js:67-82 (Sentry hits), tesla_coil_cinematics.js:25-44 (Tesla zaps), tier4_turret_fx.js:38-51 (grenade and rocket launches), mine_player_safety.js:76-118 (Claymore and Betty blasts), trap_durability.js:143-156 (trap breaks), wave_mob_fence_shock.js:40-55 (fence shocks), bounty_kills.js (death classification by damage-type id), wave_airdrop.js:340 (crate looted). Each could call qmCompleteShared/qmCompleteForPlayer for 'first X' milestones. New custom task ids must start with hex 0-7 (IDEAS.md working principles).

Quest-text inaccuracies found: 'Point and Shoot' never mentions that the Gun Turret needs ammo (TurretGunBlockEntity.canActivate requires a BulletItem in slot 0). 'The Grid' claims every chest joins the network. 'Open It' says every bag can carry Shrapnel, but the Legendary bag has none. Arsenal 'Submachine Gun' says 60 rounds, but ReloadProcedure caps it at 32, and 'Tommy Gun' says it shares the SMG's drum. 'Sentry''s locked-chest ammo route is unreachable in practice. 'Bouncing Betty' implies friendly damage. 'Fragmentation' and 'Fire for Effect' omit the base-tier and ammo requirements and list the Turret Base as an ingredient. 'No Cables Needed' targets the Flux Plug when new machines need a Flux Point. 'Electrified Fence' calls it unbreakable, which is not true for its owner.

Craftable but not in the book or the tier tooltips: SecurityCraft Mine, block mines, Track Mine, Taser, Speed and Allowlist modules, Universal Block Modifier and remote tools (securitycraft_traps.js removes none of them). OMT Machine Gun, Potato Cannon, Disposable Item and Incendiary turrets plus their upgrades and addons (tier4_turret_recipes.js only adds a recipe). The Supplementaries bomb. FEATURES.md:5313-5333 says the extra OMT heads were 'passed over', but their recipes are live. The IDEAS.md:278-285 principle ('one quest per distinct item'; the book stays in sync with what is buildable) means each needs a user decision: a quest, or a recipe removal.

Inputs with no source in this world, per the pack's loot tables: slime ball / sticky piston (Sophisticated pickup and magnet upgrades, Supplementaries slingshot and spring launcher), reinforced stone (SecurityCraft keypad, and so the Sentry's alternate-ammo chest), shulker shell (Laser Gun), glowstone (Energized Dust). Third-party structure chests were not checked.

Home-machine reward principle (IDEAS.md:149-159): 'Fragmentation' rewards 4 IE steel ingots (campaign.snbt:1210-1214), and steel is the Blast Furnace's output (tier3_loot_aligned_recipes.js:66-70). This may conflict with the principle and is the user's call. Reward candidates in this inventory avoid steel, ferronite ingots and FE.

Doc drift: FEATURES.md:1100-1130 describes older Tesla Coil, Flux Core and Flux Dust recipes (LV coils and a Flux Point; obsidian), but tier3_loot_aligned_recipes.js now uses diamond blocks and netherite; gold blocks; and a lapis block. The quest subtitles match the code, not the doc.
